profile.name: Deal finder
profile.description: Watches products you care about and only pings you when the price actually drops below your baseline — or a real sale shows up. Built for quiet weekday checks across retailers.

routines.name: Single-product sale watch
routines.description: Weekday morning check of one product URL; alerts only when the price beats your reference or is clearly marked on sale.
routines.content:
Check the live price of the watched product at its retailer product page: [PRODUCT_URL] (item [ITEM_ID] if known). The user's reference price is [REFERENCE_PRICE] — treat anything clearly below that, or marked sale/clearance/rollback with a lower current price, as "on sale." Fetch the page (browser if simple fetch is blocked). If it is on sale, tell the user the current price, any was/compare-at price, availability if shown, and the product link. If it is not on sale (at or above the reference with no sale markup), stay quiet — do not message. If the page is unreachable after a reasonable try, stay quiet unless this is a repeated failure across several runs; then tell the user the watch is stuck.

Fires on:
- cron `40 8 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Multi-retailer sale watch
routines.description: Weekday morning scan across preferred retailers (and others) for a better deal than the standing street price; stays quiet unless the drop is real.
routines.content:
Watch for a better deal on [PRODUCT_NAME], preferring [PREFERRED_COLOR_OR_VARIANT] model [MODEL_NUMBER]. The user will buy from any retailer — priority check links:
- [RETAILER_1]: [URL_1]
- [RETAILER_2]: [URL_2]
- [RETAILER_3]: [URL_3]
- [RETAILER_4]: [URL_4]
Also scan other reputable sellers and the manufacturer site for the preferred model/variant.

Baseline street price: about [STREET_PRICE] vs MSRP [MSRP] (a standing list markdown is normal — do NOT treat that alone as news).

Alert the user only when something actionable happens:
1) Preferred variant price drops to [ALERT_THRESHOLD] or below at any retailer, OR
2) A real extra promo beyond the standing MSRP markdown (clearance, open-box, warehouse deal, stackable rebate that meaningfully lowers out-the-door cost), OR
3) An exceptional deal on an alternate finish under [ALT_THRESHOLD] that might be worth considering despite the preference.

When alerting: say retailer, color/model, current price, was/compare-at if shown, link, and why it beats baseline. If nothing qualifies, stay quiet. Use the browser when simple fetches are blocked. ZIP context if needed: [USER_ZIP].

Fires on:
- cron `19 8 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
